title: Android authority and cash-attribution integration validation
scope: Experimental standalone Android checkout authority integration, exact command gates, manager recovery, provisioning safety, report authorization and cash-session v4 attribution. Regtest/test-only; no real funds or production card processing.

checks.name: complete checkout JVM model suite
includes: authority CAS and sealed-storage failure semantics
installation descriptor provisioning state and crash windows
manager enrollment, sign-in, session, recovery and secret redaction
cash-session v4 exact actor/scope attribution and legacy v1-v3 decoding
all pre-existing ledger, event, history, receipt, pricing, catalog, inventory and report tests

checks.name: Android authority source contracts
includes: signed-in rendering, five-minute expiry, Counter shutdown and synchronous resume masking
secret field persistence and clipboard exclusions
REPORT_READ gating and resumable REPORT_EXPORT reauthorization
manager-only WALLET_CONFIGURE persistence after picker lifecycle lock

checks.name: experimental checkout Android package
checks.result: passed using coordinator-provided feature-verified arm64-v8a and x86_64 native libraries; Kotlin compiled, APK dexed, aligned, test-signed and verified

implemented_boundaries: Keystore-sealed local authority record with exact installation scope
Authenticated pending/completed provisioning descriptor and anti-regeneration sentinels
First-manager enrollment, recovery-code acknowledgement, staff sign-in, expiry and lifecycle lock
Manager recovery with prepare-before-commit replacement code
Exact capability gates for merchant-started sale, tender, refund, catalog, inventory and report commands
Manager-only watch-only wallet/pairing configuration and picker continuation
Cash-session v4 immutable authority attribution; v1-v3 remain legacy/unverified
Manager-only report read and export with post-picker reauthorization
open_gates: No emulator, physical-device, merchant-shift, mainnet or production-card workflow was run.
Only the base checkout APK was compiled; the optional Square Sandbox variant and hosted CI were not run for this batch.
No Android staff-administration workflow exists beyond first-manager enrollment, sign-in and designated-manager recovery.
No migration/adoption path exists for an upgraded pre-authority installation; it fails closed.
Non-cash business records do not yet persist actor attribution.
The authority audit-journal model is not Android-wired and is not transactionally atomic with authority state.
The cash business file is not cryptographically sealed or tamper-evident.
An already-started authorized command may commit after lifecycle lock; stale UI completion is dropped and the durable result requires later reconciliation.
Provider/counter evidence callbacks are trusted observers tied to existing attempt IDs, not user-authorized commands.
Canonical capability statuses and competitor-parity claims remain unchanged.
claim_boundary: This evidence supports local model behavior, Android source wiring, and successful package compilation only. It does not establish production safety, full staff attribution, audited financial records, merchant readiness, or closure of the 502-capability benchmark.
